trust_decision.summary: The caller-supplied $filePath is trusted to be a path inside the configured disk, but Disk::copy() decides on realpath($destination) that any destination which already resolves on the local filesystem must be written directly with fopen('rb+') + stream_copy_to_stream, bypassing Flysystem and its disk root; so Excel::store()/queue() can write or overwrite any file the PHP process can reach (CWE-22/CWE-73).

landing_point.why: The summary says an export is written outside the configured disk when given a caller-controlled path; $filePath enters the library at Excel::store(), which exports to a temporary file and then hands both the temp file and $filePath to $this->filesystem->disk(...)->copy() (src/Excel.php:110), the first thing an engineer would read.

fix_sites.entry_point: temporary-file sync, selected by excel.temporary_files.remote_disk (src/Files/TemporaryFileFactory.php:35-40), used by Writer::reopen() (src/Writer.php:140) and Jobs\ReadChunk (src/Jobs/ReadChunk.php:194)

fix_sites.module_kind: public API / facade entry point (temporary-file cleanup on failure)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The sync() destination is the library's own local temporary file used only for remote temp disks (excel.temporary_files.remote_disk), not the caller's export path the report names, so a solver can argue the report's scope ends at Excel::store() and that this internal copy no longer has anything to do with it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: With excel.temporary_files.remote_disk configured, RemoteTemporaryFile::sync() must still land the remote temporary object at the local temporary path (Writer::reopen and Jobs\ReadChunk read it), and storing over an existing disk file must still truncate it (the old fopen 'rb+' path did not). A fix that just deletes the local-write branch in Disk::copy() silently breaks the remote-temp-disk route.

O6_input_shapes: relative path containing traversal segments, e.g. '../elsewhere.csv' (fix.diff:86-110)
destination that already exists on the local filesystem (realpath() true) versus one that does not (realpath() false) - two branches before the fix, one after
path passed as the method argument versus falling back to the export object's $filePath/$disk properties (src/Concerns/Exportable.php:44-56)
synchronous store versus an export implementing ShouldQueue, which Excel::store() silently routes to the queued job (src/Excel.php:104-106)

O7_producer.where: src/Files/TemporaryFileFactory.php:33-40 (chosen from config('excel.temporary_files.remote_disk'), bound in src/ExcelServiceProvider.php:82-87; key at config/excel.php:360), which produces RemoteTemporaryFile whose local path reaches Disk::copy() in RemoteTemporaryFile::sync()

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Queued export: Excel::queue() / Exportable::queue() / store() on a ShouldQueue export passes the same caller-controlled $filePath to Jobs\StoreQueuedExport::handle(), which calls disk->copy() with no path handling; the published fix does not touch that file.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Queue workers are a different feature from the synchronous store() the report shows, and the report's example never mentions queueing, so the route looks out of scope.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: one directory away (src/Jobs vs src/Files), same package

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Disk::touch() could take the same 'if the path resolves locally, touch it directly' shortcut instead of disk->put()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it is the same wrapper class and the same local-path convenience the realpath() branch expressed; a maintainer adding an empty-placeholder fast path would copy that idiom

O8b_injection_room.sibling: copyFrom() already has the mirror image (realpath($filePath) when no disk is given) for the read direction, so a write-side sibling built on the same shortcut is plausible
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the local-path shortcut is an existing idiom in this file, so a maintainer adding another transfer would repeat it

O8b_injection_room.sibling: LocalTemporaryFile::put() writes with file_put_contents() to a factory-built path; letting a caller-influenced name through it is a second unprotected writer
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: RemoteTemporaryFile::sync() already feeds a name derived from the remote filename into makeLocal() and then put() (src/Files/RemoteTemporaryFile.php:98-101, 108)

O9_family: path traversal / arbitrary file write outside the configured disk (CWE-22, CWE-73)
